steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Use the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Use the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Record that Vendor A's response is present before opening Rejected Bids.
Record the displayed bid value before the dialog interaction.
Open the RFQ stage's Rejected Bids window.
Confirm the Rejected Bids window opened.
Perform the case's Close action on the Rejected Bids window.
Assert that Close dismisses the Rejected Bids window.
Confirm the response view still contains Vendor A after closing the window.
Confirm the displayed bid value remains unchanged after closing the window.
Assert that closing the window did not leave an error or rendering issue.
